affected_boundaries: durable host-action scheduling and serialized integration lane

observed_behavior: One pending rebase prevented dispatch of every unrelated dependency-ready campaign item.
expected_behavior: Independent assignment-local dispatch proceeds while one durable integration action remains outstanding.
causal_mechanism: A campaign-wide scalar pendingAction represented durable retry state and also acted as a global scheduler gate, extending the integration lane's serialization requirement to unrelated host effects.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A scheduler stores heterogeneous independent effects in one scalar pending slot and returns that slot before selecting other ready work.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The narrowest serialized resource becomes an accidental campaign-wide mutex, so unrelated work cannot make progress.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Durable host actions are assignment-local while only the integration lane is serialized.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Persist a pending-actions collection, allow at most one action per assignment and one rebase overall, route results by action identifier, and pin the rebase target revision until its named result arrives.

applicability_conditions: A durable scheduler coordinates independent host effects plus a narrower serialized lane.
known_non_matches: Blocking campaign diagnostics intentionally stop every unsafe mutation.
confirmation_evidence: The failing-first regression returned REQUEST_REBASE instead of CREATE_WORKER; the corrected test retains one rebase while adding two independent dispatch actions.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: independent dispatch continues while the integration lane has one outstanding rebase
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: an outstanding rebase pins the integration revision until its named result
